task_title: Standing verdict-coverage audit guard: detect complete-without-verdict and stale in_progress gitreins lifecycles
task_criteria: PROOF: .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_gitreins_verdict_audit.py -q exits 0 with every test passing on the graded tree; python3 scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py . exits 0 printing a summary naming window, tasks audited, verdicts found, and exceptions skipped (DF-AIPP-13-R3 expected in exceptions); with a synthetic tasks.yaml fixture holding a completed task inside the audit window with no verdict.json and no exception entry, the script exits 1 naming that task id (asserted by unit test, not live state). ruff check src/ tests/ --quiet exits 0 and mypy scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py reports no errors. FAILIF: any pytest failure, exit 0 on the synthetic orphan fixture, live-tree exit non-zero, or the audit covering only in_progress tasks.

items.criterion: PROOF: .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_gitreins_verdict_audit.py -q exits 0 with every test passing on the graded tree; python3 scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py . exits 0 printing a summary naming window, tasks audited, verdicts found, and exceptions skipped (DF-AIPP-13-R3 expected in exceptions); with a synthetic tasks.yaml fixture holding a completed task inside the audit window with no verdict.json and no exception entry, the script exits 1 naming that task id (asserted by unit test, not live state). ruff check src/ tests/ --quiet exits 0 and mypy scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py reports no errors. FAILIF: any pytest failure, exit 0 on the synthetic orphan fixture, live-tree exit non-zero, or the audit covering only in_progress tasks.
items.detail: Most sub-elements pass: pytest exit_code=0 '14 passed in 0.23s'; ruff exit 0 and .venv/bin/ruff exit 0 (clean on src/ tests/ --quiet); mypy 'Success: no issues found in 1 source file'; synthetic orphan asserted by tests/test_gitreins_verdict_audit.py:84-100 (main==1, 'ORPHAN-NOVERDICT: T-ORPHAN'). BUT the live-tree run fails the explicit FAILIF 'live-tree exit non-zero': `python3 scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py .` printed 'tasks_audited: 224 / verdicts_found: 306 / exceptions_skipped: 2 (DF-AIPP-13-R3 + DEPS-005)' yet exited 1 with 'ORPHAN-NOVERDICT: INT-GATE-2' and 'RESULT: FAIL (orphan tasks: INT-GATE-2)'. Cause: the task's own row was flipped to status: complete with completed_at '2026-11-25T07:34:52.530270+00:00' (verified in .gitreins/tasks.yaml), i.e. inside the 30-day window, while no verdict.json naming INT-GATE-2 exists anywhere under .gitreins/history (grep '"task_id": "INT-GATE-2"' --include=verdict.json over .gitreins/history = 0 hits) and .gitreins/verdict_audit_exceptions.yaml contains no INT-GATE-2 entry (only DF-AIPP-13-R3, DEPS-005). The guard works exactly as designed — and its own closeout is the first instance of the defect class it was built to catch.

items.criterion: The audit flags completed tasks inside the window, not only in_progress ones (FAILIF clause: 'the audit covering only in_progress tasks')
items.detail: scripts/gitreins_verdict_audit.py:268-273 has an `elif status == "complete":` branch appending to orphan_noverdict when completed_at >= now-window_days; the live run reached it (flagged complete task INT-GATE-2, an in_progress flag would be impossible for that row), and test_fresh_in_progress_and_old_complete_not_flagged plus test_complete_without_verdict_inside_window_fails cover both sides.

items.criterion: The synthetic completed-task-in-window orphan fixture makes the script exit 1 naming that task id, asserted by unit test rather than live state
items.detail: tests/test_gitreins_verdict_audit.py:84-100 (test_complete_without_verdict_inside_window_fails) builds the exact fixture named in the criterion (completed_at now-1d, no verdict.json, no exceptions file) and asserts audit_mod.main([str(root)]) == 1 with 'ORPHAN-NOVERDICT: T-ORPHAN' in stdout; fresh run of the module: exit_code 0, '14 passed in 0.23s'.
